createpop.brewers_guide.section.overview: Create: Pop revolves around turning plain water into carbonated water, then combining that base with potions, sodas, dyes, or stabilisers in a Create mixer.
createpop.brewers_guide.section.first_so: Once you have a base soda, you can remix it with other sodas, recolour it with
, or stabilise it if the recipe starts getting unruly. A tier-1 negative plus a tier-2 negative might still cascade into several positive results if the reaction breaks your way.
createpop.brewers_guide.section.rules.li: lets you recolour an existing soda without changing its core effects, which is useful for theming batches or marking stronger blends.
createpop.brewers_guide.section.instabil: A little instability can be manageable, but if you are chasing polished recipes, stabilise between major remix steps instead of waiting until the very end.
